items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: Mr. Big Stuff with Gene Knight was in that, it was in that situation. Uh-huh. They paid the, they paid the musicians and supplied the studio time, and then they'll take out the studio time and what they put out for the musicians and things of that sort, and then we'll split the production money off

ctx.x: So, so what, were y'all on our, uh, somebody, these other people were putting up the money?

Well, we all, we all, we all, we all put up the money. Uh, you know, sometimes some of the musicians, uh, did it for, uh, some of the musicians did it for, uh, for not for the right, uh, right amount of money. Uh, for instance, like, it must have been, uh, it must have been, uh, a barefootin'. Like a lot of my friends came in and we did the record. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. And for a small amount of fee. But you see, after the record came out and we made a little noise, and we got some money in for it, we, we took care of…
Do you remember something like that, the Big Stuff? Do you remember that being a special arrangement for you? Mr. Big Stuff?
